'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Mike Kessler DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessler]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / Yes, I Think They're Still Getting Louder|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Yes, I Think They're Still Getting Louder (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Kessler
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
